case_name: Smt. Aarti Dhomoniya W/O Deepak Goyar vs Deepak Goyar S/O Shri Premprakash Goyar
facts_of_case: Matrimonial dispute; applicant-wife seeks transfer of case from Family Court No. 2, Jaipur to Family Court Ajmer.

legal_principles.principle: The court may transfer a case to another court if the applicant is financially deprived and lacks infrastructural support.
legal_principles.held: Considering that the applicant is presently residing with her aged parents in Ajmer; that the applicant does not have the infrastructural support, in terms of family members, who can accompany her to court proceedings pending in District Jaipur;
cited_cases: N.C.V. Aishwarya vs. A.S. Saravana Karthik Sha: Civil Appeal No. 4894/2022
Sumita Singh Vs. Kumar Sanjay & Ors.: AIR 2002 SC 396
Rajni Kishor Pardeshi Vs. Kishor Babulal Pardeshi: (2005) 12 SCC 237
Vaishali Shridhar Jagtap Vs. Shridhar Vishwanath Jagtap: AIR 2016 SC 3584

legal_principles.principle: The court may transfer a case to another court if the applicant apprehends threat to their life and liberty.
legal_principles.held: that the applicant apprehends threat to her life and liberty at Jaipur;
cited_cases: N.C.V. Aishwarya vs. A.S. Saravana Karthik Sha: Civil Appeal No. 4894/2022
Sumita Singh Vs. Kumar Sanjay & Ors.: AIR 2002 SC 396
Rajni Kishor Pardeshi Vs. Kishor Babulal Pardeshi: (2005) 12 SCC 237
Vaishali Shridhar Jagtap Vs. Shridhar Vishwanath Jagtap: AIR 2016 SC 3584

outcome.final_order: Case transferred from Family Court No. 2, Jaipur to Family Court Ajmer.
